bild.info_vae: Converts the model's output into visible pixels. Default uses the VAE included in the model.
bild.info_vae_format: The internal format expected by the VAE. Auto reads it from the model.
bild.info_clip_skip: Skips the final layers of the text encoder: 1 skips none, 2 skips one. Auto selects the value based on the model version.
bild.info_rng: Source of the random noise. The same seed produces the same image only when the noise source is also unchanged.
bild.info_weight_type: Numeric format used to load the weights. Smaller formats use less memory but reduce numerical precision.
bild.info_prediction: The quantity the model was trained to predict. Auto reads it from the model. Set it manually only if the model is misidentified.
bild.info_familie: Model type, which determines default values and required encoders. Automatic reads it from the file.
bild.info_guidance: How closely a guidance-distilled model such as Flux follows the prompt.
bild.info_staerke: How much of the input image is regenerated. 0 preserves it; 1 regenerates it entirely.
bild.info_breite: The width of the picture in pixels.
bild.info_hoehe: The height of the picture in pixels.
bild.info_schritte: Number of generation steps. More steps take longer.
bild.info_cfg: How closely the image follows the prompt. Higher values enforce closer adherence.
bild.info_sampler: The method that removes the noise step by step.
bild.info_scheduler: How noise levels are distributed across the steps. Auto lets the program choose.
bild.info_seed: Initial value used to generate noise. The same value with identical settings produces the same image.
bild.info_seed_modus: How the seed changes between images: a new value each time, a fixed value, or an increase or decrease of one.
bild.info_bilder_zahl: Number of images generated each time you select Generate.
bild.info_lora: Small add-on files that teach the model a style, person, or subject. The slider controls the strength of their influence.
bild.info_lora_modus: How a LoRA is applied. Auto selects the method based on the model's weights.
bild.info_embedding: Learned terms for the prompt, loaded from the embeddings folder.
bild.info_photomaker: Transfers a face from your photos into the image.
bild.info_adetailer: Detects faces in the finished image and regenerates them with greater detail.
bild.info_ad_prompt: Prompt used to refine faces. If empty, the main prompt is used.
bild.info_ad_negativ: Elements to exclude when refining faces. If empty, the main negative prompt is used.
bild.info_ad_confidence: Minimum confidence required to classify a detected area as a face.
bild.info_pulid: Transfers facial identity from a photograph into the image. For Flux.
bild.info_pulid_id_weight: How strongly the face in the result resembles the reference photo.
bild.info_control_net: Guides the image using the shape or pose in a reference image.
bild.info_control_strength: How closely the image follows the reference image.
bild.info_canny: Detects the edges in the reference image and uses them as guidance.
bild.info_hires: Regenerates the image at a larger size in a second pass.
bild.info_hires_steps: Number of steps in the second pass. Auto uses the same number as the first pass.
bild.info_hires_denoise: How much the second pass changes. Lower values preserve more of the image; higher values regenerate more.
bild.info_hires_upscaler: How the picture is enlarged before the second pass.
bild.info_hires_breite: Width after enlargement. Auto uses the factor above.
bild.info_hires_hoehe: Height after enlargement. Auto uses the factor above.
bild.info_slg_scale: Skip Layer Guidance for DiT models such as SD3 can enhance detail. 0 disables it.
bild.info_skip_layers: Layers skipped by Skip Layer Guidance.
bild.info_skip_layer_start: Fraction of the generation steps at which Skip Layer Guidance begins.
bild.info_skip_layer_end: Fraction of the generation steps at which Skip Layer Guidance ends.
bild.info_live_preview: Displays the image during generation. The selected option determines how the preview is produced.
bild.info_eta: Amount of new noise added by certain samplers at each step. Leave empty to retain the sampler's default.
bild.info_flow_shift: Shifts the steps for flow models such as SD3 or Wan. Leave empty to use the model's default.
bild.info_sigmas: Custom noise levels for each step, replacing the scheduler's levels.
bild.info_extra_sample_args: Additional sampler settings as key=value pairs, passed through unchanged.
bild.info_vram_limit: Graphics memory budget for weights and working buffers, in GiB. Leave empty (auto) to use the available memory.
bild.info_offload: Keeps weights in RAM and transfers them to graphics memory only when needed. Uses less graphics memory but takes longer.
bild.info_threads: Number of processor threads to use. Leave empty (all) to use one thread per physical core.
bild.info_split_mode: How weights are distributed across multiple graphics cards.
bild.info_backend: Device assigned to each part of the computation, for example cpu or vae=cpu.
bild.info_model_args: Additional model settings as key=value pairs, passed through unchanged.
bild.info_img_cfg: How closely an edit follows the reference images. Auto uses the CFG value.
bild.info_ref_image_args: Reference image processing options as key=value pairs, for example preset=qwen. Leave empty to use the model's default.
bild.info_increase_ref_index: Numbers the reference images sequentially in the order provided.
bild.info_pulid_embedding: A precomputed face embedding (.pulidembd) from the PuLID folder. A photograph cannot be used here.
bild.info_sw_circular: Pads the image around its edges so it can be tiled seamlessly.
bild.info_sw_circularx: Tiles seamlessly left to right only.
bild.info_sw_circulary: Tiles seamlessly top to bottom only.
bild.info_sw_output_format: The format the picture is saved in. Auto saves a PNG.
bild.info_sw_compression_quality: JPEG quality from 0 to 100. Leave empty to use 90.
bild.info_sw_qwen_image_layers: Number of layers into which Qwen Image Layered separates the image. The output contains one more image than this value.
bild.info_sw_timestep_shift: Shifts the timestep for NitroFusion models. About 250 suits NitroSD-Realism, 500 NitroSD-Vibrant.
bild.info_sw_sampler_rng: Random noise source used by the sampler. Auto uses the RNG selected above.
bild.info_sw_sample_guidance_schedule: A separate CFG value for each step rather than one value for all steps.
bild.info_sw_sample_apg_eta: Adaptive projected guidance: proportion of the parallel component retained.
bild.info_sw_sample_apg_momentum: Adaptive projected guidance: contribution retained from the previous step.
bild.info_sw_sample_apg_norm_threshold: Adaptive projected guidance: length to which the guidance vector is limited.
bild.info_sw_sample_apg_norm_threshold_smooth: Adaptive projected guidance: softness of the threshold's limiting effect.
bild.info_sw_sample_slg_uncond: Applies Skip Layer Guidance during the negative pass rather than an additional pass.
bild.info_sw_sample_noise_clip_std: LCM: limits newly added noise to this number of standard deviations.
bild.info_sw_sample_noise_scale_start: LCM: the strength of the fresh noise at the first step.
bild.info_sw_sample_noise_scale_end: LCM: the strength of the fresh noise at the last step.
bild.info_sw_sample_base_shift: Flux and LTX-2 schedulers: the shift for a small picture.
bild.info_sw_sample_max_shift: Flux and LTX-2 schedulers: the shift for a large picture.
bild.info_sw_sample_stretch: LTX-2 scheduler: stretches the schedule towards its end value.
bild.info_sw_sample_terminal: LTX-2 scheduler: the value the schedule ends on.
bild.info_sw_sample_alpha: Alpha parameter of the beta scheduler; must be greater than 0.
bild.info_sw_sample_beta: Beta parameter of the beta scheduler; must be greater than 0.
bild.info_sw_sample_logsnr_min: logit_normal scheduler: the lowest log signal-to-noise ratio.
bild.info_sw_sample_logsnr_max: logit_normal scheduler: the highest log signal-to-noise ratio.
bild.info_sw_sample_resolution_aware: Adjusts the logit_normal scheduler to the image size.
bild.info_sw_sample_uniform: Uses evenly spaced steps in the llada_image scheduler.
bild.info_sw_sample_lms_max_order: Sampler lms: the highest order, at least 1.
bild.info_sw_sample_lms_shift: Sampler lms: its shift, at least 0.
bild.info_sw_sample_noise_sampler: Samplers that add noise: iid or brownian_tree.
bild.info_sw_cache_mode: Reuses intermediate results between steps to speed up generation. easycache is for DiT, ucache for U-Net, dbcache, taylorseer, and cache-dit operate per block, and spectrum supports both.
bild.info_sw_cache_option: Cache settings as key=value pairs, for example threshold=0.25.
bild.info_sw_scm_mask: cache-dit: one 0 or 1 per step. 1 requires computation; 0 allows reuse.
bild.info_sw_conditioning_cache_size: Number of prompt encodings to retain. 0 disables retention.
bild.info_sw_fa: Uses Flash Attention in every model, including the text encoder.
bild.info_sw_sage_attn: Uses SageAttention in the diffusion model with CUDA. Otherwise, standard attention is used.
bild.info_sw_diffusion_conv_direct: Direct 2D convolution in the diffusion model.
bild.info_sw_vae_conv_direct: Direct 2D and 3D convolution in the VAE.
bild.info_sw_linear_scale: Scales linear inputs. 1 leaves them unchanged. May help prevent black images.
bild.info_sw_attn_scale: Scales K and V in Flash Attention. 1 leaves them unchanged. Requires Flash Attention.
bild.info_sw_params_backend: Storage location for weights, for example disk, cpu, or diffusion=disk,clip=cpu. Disables automatic placement.
bild.info_sw_auto_fit: Distributes weights between graphics memory, RAM, and disk according to available capacity. Auto enables this feature.
bild.info_sw_eager_load: Loads all weights at startup rather than on first use.
bild.info_sw_mmap: Maps the model file into memory instead of reading it.
bild.info_sw_disable_prefetch: Disables prefetching of the next portion of the weights.
bild.info_sw_disable_segmented_compute: Processes the model as a whole, even when it would otherwise be split automatically.
bild.info_sw_vae_tiling: Encodes and decodes in tiles to reduce memory use.
bild.info_sw_vae_tile_size: Size in pixels, specified as WxH or a single number. Defaults to 256 when empty.
bild.info_sw_vae_tile_overlap: Overlap between adjacent tiles as a fraction of tile size. Defaults to 0.5 when empty.
bild.info_sw_vae_relative_tile_size: WxH or a single number. Values up to 1 specify a fraction of the image; values above 1 specify the number of tiles. Takes precedence over tile size.
bild.info_sw_force_sdxl_vae_conv_scale: Forces the convolution scale on an SDXL VAE.
bild.info_sw_tensor_type_rules: A weight type per tensor pattern, for example ^vae\.=f16,model\.=q8_0.
bild.info_sw_hires_sigmas: Custom sigma values for the second pass, separated by commas.
bild.info_sw_hires_upscale_tile_size: Tile size used by an upscaler model in the second pass. Defaults to 128 when empty.
bild.info_sw_ip_adapter: Transfers style or subject from an image. The file is stored in the ipadapter folder.
bild.info_sw_clip_vision: Image encoder required by the IP-Adapter and Wan 2.1 models for image-to-video and first-and-last-frame generation.
bild.info_sw_ip_adapter_image: The picture the IP-Adapter takes style or subject from.
bild.info_sw_ip_adapter_strength: Strength of the reference image's influence. Defaults to 1 when empty.
bild.info_sw_pm_id_embed: The finished face file of PhotoMaker v2 from the photomaker folder.
bild.info_sw_pm_style_strength: How strongly the prompt's style takes precedence over the reference face photos.
bild.info_sw_ad_input_size: Image size used by the detector.
bild.info_sw_ad_nms: Maximum overlap between two detected faces before one is excluded.
bild.info_sw_ad_max_detections: Maximum number of faces to detect.
bild.info_sw_ad_mask_k_largest: Limits regeneration to this number of the largest faces.
bild.info_sw_ad_mask_min_ratio: Faces smaller than this fraction of the image are left unchanged.
bild.info_sw_ad_mask_max_ratio: Faces larger than this fraction of the image are left unchanged.
bild.info_sw_ad_dilate_erode: Number of pixels by which to expand the mask. Negative values shrink it.
bild.info_sw_ad_x_offset: Shifts the mask by this many pixels to the right.
bild.info_sw_ad_y_offset: Shifts the mask by this many pixels upwards.
bild.info_sw_ad_mask_mode: none: each face alone. merge: all together. merge_invert: everything but the faces.
bild.info_sw_ad_merge_masks: Redraws all faces in one pass.
bild.info_sw_ad_mask_blur: Width of the mask's soft edge, in pixels.
bild.info_sw_ad_inpaint_padding: Number of surrounding pixels included when regenerating each face.
bild.info_sw_ad_inpaint_width: The width a face is redrawn at.
bild.info_sw_ad_inpaint_height: The height a face is redrawn at.
bild.info_sw_ad_denoising_strength: How much of a face is painted over.
bild.info_sw_ad_sort_by: The order the faces are redrawn in.

bild.vorschau_fehlt: There is no preview of the picture yet.
bild.info_preview_interval: Preview update frequency. N: every Nth step. -N: only after step N. 0: once after the first pass. Empty: every step.
bild.info_preview_noisy: Shows the noisy model input instead of the denoised image.
bild.info_taesd: A small autoencoder for quickly decoding the TAE preview. Used only for previews. The file is stored in the taesd folder.
bild.infos_keine: The image contains no generation metadata.
bild.modus_unvollstaendig: Requires a completed image as input and a detector or upscaler model.
bild.umwandeln_da: A converted file of this type already exists.
bild.umwandeln_gescheitert: The file could not be converted.
bild.info_video_frames: Number of video frames. sd.cpp rounds down to the model's supported step size: 33 remains 33, while 34 becomes 33. Leave empty to generate one frame.
bild.info_fps: Video playback rate. Defaults to 24 frames per second when empty. Some models retain their own rate.
bild.kein_video_aus_bild: This model cannot generate video from an image.
bild.info_sw_video_format: The file the video is written as. WebM plays everywhere, WebP is an animated picture, AVI plays in a video player.
bild.info_sw_moe_boundary: Point at which Wan 2.2 A14B switches from the high-noise model to the main model. Applies only when high-noise steps are set automatically.
bild.info_sw_vace_strength: How strongly Wan VACE follows the control video.
bild.info_sw_temporal_tiling: Decodes the video a few frames at a time to reduce memory use.
bild.info_sw_tiling_temporal_tile_frames: Number of frames in each temporal tile.
bild.info_sw_tiling_temporal_tile_overlap: Number of frames shared by adjacent temporal tiles.
bild.info_sw_motion_module: AnimateDiff: turns an SD 1.5 model into a video model. From the animatediff folder.
bild.info_sw_audio: Wan 2.2 S2V: WAV file that drives the portrait's speech. Loaded from the audio folder.
bild.info_sw_ref_audio: MiniMax-H3: a WAV file the sound of the video follows. From the audio folder.
bild.info_sw_ref_video_audio: MiniMax-H3: the WAV file with the sound of the reference video. From the audio folder.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_steps: Number of steps performed by the high-noise model. Leave empty to let sd.cpp allocate them automatically.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_cfg_scale: The CFG of the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_img_cfg_scale: The image CFG of the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_guidance: The distilled guidance of the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_sampling_method: The sampler of the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_eta: The noise multiplier of the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_slg_scale: Skip layer guidance in the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_skip_layer_start: Where skip layer guidance begins in the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_skip_layer_end: Where skip layer guidance ends in the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_skip_layers: The layers skip layer guidance leaves out in the high-noise steps, for example 7,8,9.
bild.video_unmoeglich: This model cannot generate video. Use a video model or an SD 1.5 model with a motion module.
bild.umwandeln_nicht_kleiner: A copy in this weight type would not be smaller.

katalog.keine_kuratierten: No curated models of this type yet. Use the search above.
katalog.satz_occamy: Qwen3.6 35B A3B fine-tune from Accio, APEX-I MiniPlus build by IsValorum.
katalog.lang_occamy: Mixture-of-experts fine-tune of Qwen3.6 35B A3B by Accio for agentic work: 3B active parameters per token, tool calling, image input, reasoning, 262K context. APEX-I MiniPlus V2.1 quantisation by IsValorum.
katalog.satz_gptoss: OpenAI's GPT-OSS 20B, original weights, with vision and a repaired tool-call template by SoAI.
katalog.lang_gptoss: Mixture of experts from OpenAI: 21B parameters, 3.6B active per token, reasoning always on, tool calling, 128K context. SoAI's V2 build keeps the released MXFP4 weights unchanged, fixes the chat template for clean tool calls and adds image input through an InternVL encoder.
katalog.satz_qwen38: Qwen3.8 27B, quantised to IQ3_S by ISTA-DASLab (GSQ-RCO).
katalog.lang_qwen38: Dense 27B multimodal model from Alibaba's Qwen team, quantised to IQ3_S by ISTA-DASLab using GSQ-RCO. Supports tool calls and image input, with a 262K context.
katalog.lang_ornith: Dense 9B fine-tune of Qwen3.5 by Ornith AI, trained through self-improvement for coding and agent tasks. Supports tool calls and image input, with a 262K context. Q4_K_M quantisation.
katalog.satz_spark: SparkLLM's Spark-X2.5 4B, in the Sharp-Spark build by peculiar-ragdoll.
katalog.lang_spark: Dense 4B model from SparkLLM with hybrid attention and a native 1M-token context, offering strong coding and agent performance for its size. Supports tool calls and reasoning. The Sharp-Spark version uses imatrix quantisation (Q6_K_XL) and a corrected chat template.
katalog.satz_gemmae2b: Gemma 4 E2B from Google, in Unsloth's 2-bit QAT mobile build.
katalog.lang_gemmae2b: Google's smallest Gemma 4, trained with quantisation awareness and packaged by Unsloth for mobile hardware. Features 2-bit quantisation (UD-Q2_K_XL), tool calls, image input, an MTP drafter for faster responses, and a 128K context.
katalog.satz_animaginexl: Animagine XL 3.0 fine-tune from Cagliostro Lab, version 3.1.
katalog.satz_zub_lora: An acceleration LoRA that produces usable images in a few steps rather than twenty.
katalog.satz_zub_vae: A VAE converts the model's internal representation into visible pixels for cleaner colors and finer detail.
katalog.satz_zub_adetailer: An ADetailer detector — finds faces, hands or people in the finished image and sharpens each one.
katalog.satz_zub_mtp: A speed module (MTP) runs alongside the language model to accelerate responses. Store it in the model folder.
katalog.satz_zub_mmproj: Vision: the projector that enables a language model to process images. Store it in the model folder.
katalog.satz_emb_qwen3: Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B from Alibaba, GGUF build by the Qwen team.
katalog.satz_emb_nomic: Nomic Embed Text v1.5 from Nomic AI, GGUF build by Nomic AI.
katalog.satz_emb_gemma: EmbeddingGemma 300M from Google, GGUF build by Unsloth.
katalog.satz_emb_bgem3: BGE-M3 from BAAI, GGUF build by GPUStack.
katalog.satz_emb_mxbai: mxbai-embed-large v1 from Mixedbread, GGUF build by ChristianAzinn.
katalog.satz_emb_minilm: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 from Sentence Transformers, GGUF build by Second State.
katalog.satz_asr_qwen3_06: Qwen3-ASR 0.6B from Alibaba, GGUF build by unslothai.
katalog.satz_asr_qwen3_17: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B from Alibaba, GGUF build by ggml-org.
katalog.satz_voxtral_3b: Voxtral Mini 3B from Mistral AI, GGUF build by ggml-org.
katalog.satz_tts_qwen3_17: Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 1.7B Base from Alibaba, GGUF build by ggml-org.

cli.cmd_chats:
Choose a chat
Typing in the list searches; digits choose by number. Examples: /chats 2 opens chat 2; /chats archive shows archived chats.

Start or stop a server, or view its log
Examples: /server stop stops the model server; /server log agent shows the agent server's log.

Search for a model and download it
Example: /download gemma 3 12b. Cancel a running download with /download stop.

Add or remove a cloud provider
Example: /provider add anthropic

Set up language, theme, preferred name and model

Show and change settings
Example: /settings global.verdichtung_schwelle 70
cli.cmd_agents:
Start and follow tasks for agents, or edit agents
Start a task, for example: /agents run researcher summarize the open issues. Edit an agent with /agents edit researcher.
cli.cmd_cron:
Create, run, pause or remove cronjobs
Examples: /cron add asks for each field in turn; /cron run 2 runs cronjob 2 now; /cron pause 2, /cron resume 2 and /cron remove 2 work the same way.
cli.cmd_tools:
Activate or deactivate tools
Examples: /tools 3 switches tool 3 between active and inactive; /tools forget read_file revokes the “Always allow” permission for read_file.
